about_the_game:
In this gripping narrative game blending exploration and chills, you play as Alexis-Philippe, an urban exploration enthusiast in search of thrills and forgotten places. Your curiosity leads you to the decaying gates of an abandoned hospital, lost deep within a dense and silent forest—forgotten by all… or almost all.

What was meant to be a simple nighttime exploration quickly turns into a true nightmare. The air is heavy, thick with a troubled past and barely audible whispers. Dark hallways, operating rooms frozen in time, scattered medical records… Every room hides a fragment of a chilling story you’ll need to piece together.

But be warned: within these time-worn walls, some secrets don’t want to be uncovered. The hospital feels alive, aware of your presence. The further you go, the more tangible the danger becomes. Will you find your way out before it’s too late?
Or will you become trapped in this cursed place… forever?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10-11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-2500K ou AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 960 ou AMD Radeon R9 380
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10-11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core I5-8400 ou AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 ou AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: You play as Alexis-Philippe, an urban explorer caught in a horror story as he uncovers the secrets of an abandoned hospital. You’ll have to explore its dark corridors and uncover its mysterious secrets if you hope to make it out alive… or not.
